title: 第11章 铁矿遭袭师父断手第12章 筑基
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 河水滔滔，冲洗李牧火全身。
以李牧火为中心，周围三米的水域，逐渐被染黑。数十米之内，水面上翻肚皮的大鱼不下百条。
并且，这些大鱼正以肉眼可见的速度在干瘪，一道道淡红色的精气自鱼体内溢出，纷纷没入李牧火的体内。
然而，这还不够，当淬体进程过半时，河边芦苇竟都开始枯萎，岸上草木也逐渐变得枯黄。
周围的一切，都似乎在为他的突破贡献力量。
而且，李牧火影响的范围越来越大，这让他意识到，和练气不同，炼体所需的是元气。元气来自活体生命和草木精华的生机，又或是自身长期积养而来。
自己短期内，实现巨大突破，已不是自身元气能够供给，所以才对自然界进行了元气虹吸。
好在，此刻乃是深夜，无人察觉这野河的变化。
直到一个多时辰后，李牧火从河中爬出，身体轻轻一震，身上和衣物里的水渍顷刻间化作水汽，被轻松震散。
这一刻，他感觉自己异常强大，似乎只要自己愿意，拳可破虚轰山，便是上品凡器，也可以轻松捏成铁饼。
于感官上，他虽没有诞生结丹强者所谓的神识，但李牧火发现自己的五感却有恐怖提升，他甚至能感受到千米之外的微弱震动，能感受到风吹拂在身上时的流动状态，甚至能清晰的感受到一粒灰尘落在自己身上的重量。
为了印证自己的实力，李牧火随手捡起一块地上的碎石，只是随意地屈指一弹，便见一道微弱白光一闪而逝，下一刻，不远处的一块至少数百斤巨石，竟是轰然炸开。
李牧火连忙四顾，然后溜也似的消失在夜幕里。
在离开时，李牧火还观察了一番，发现千米之内，万物凋零，连大树都直接枯死，可想自己突破时所需元气之磅礴。
“看来，下次再要推演修行炼体功法，得准备大量的元气丹才行。”
李牧火趁着夜色，悄悄回到坊里，至于河边的异象，他也无可奈何，只能装作什么都不知道。
次日早。
李牧火如往日那般，被林越喊起来练刀。
在李牧火打开屋门时，林越明显一愣，有些疑惑地打量起李牧火来。
李牧火顿时心头一紧，有些犯嘀咕，莫不是自己变化有点大了？
他回来后明明还自我审查了一遍，除了身体看起来比之前瘦了些，肌肉更紧实了些，皮肤略微光滑了些，好像并没有什么特别大的变化。
却听林越道：“你的铁骨功又突破了？”
李牧火连忙点头，并诧异道：“师兄你怎么知道？”
林越一听果然如此，便道：“虽然变化不大，但我仍能看出你整个人气质有所提升。”
说罢，林越又轻哼一声道：“就你还总说自己资质不行，炼体是公认的比练气更难，你能在短短三年，晋升淬体四重，已经不算多见。至少，若你入门时就展露出有炼体天赋，就肯定不会分配到杂役弟子中来。”
李牧火闻言，心下还是微微警醒，自己进步得还是太快了。
炼体一途，对身体改造还是过于明显了些。看来，以后还是得将练气功法修起来才是，至少那个不会出现外在的变化。
片刻后，两人继续开始练刀。
没一会儿，三师兄就打着哈欠钻进了膳房做早饭，钱朵朵似乎长了眼睛似的，在三师兄钻进膳房后不到十息，也便出了门，直奔膳房。
content_en:
The river was surging, washing Li Muhuo's whole body.
With Li Muhuo as the center, the surrounding three meters of water gradually turned black. Within tens of meters, there were no less than a hundred big fish with their bellies turned upside down on the water.
Moreover, these big fish were shriveling up at a speed visible to the naked eye, and streaks of light red essence overflowed from the fish's body and entered Li Muhuo's body one after another.
However, this was not enough. When the body tempering process was halfway through, the reeds on the riverside began to wither, and the vegetation on the bank gradually turned yellow.
Everything around him seemed to be contributing to his breakthrough.
Moreover, the scope of Li Muhuo's influence was getting wider and wider, which made him realize that unlike Qi training, what was needed for body training was vitality. The vitality comes from the vitality of living life and the essence of plants and trees, or it may be accumulated by oneself over a long period of time.
In order to achieve a huge breakthrough in a short period of time, my own vitality could no longer be supplied, so I siphoned vitality from nature.
Fortunately, it was late at night and no one noticed the changes in the wild river.
It wasn't until more than an hour later that Li Muhuo climbed out of the river. His body shook slightly. The water stains on his body and clothes instantly turned into water vapor and were easily dispersed.
At this moment, he felt extremely powerful. It seemed that as long as he wanted to, his punch could break through the Xu Hong Mountain, and even a top-grade mortal weapon could be easily shaped into a discus.
In terms of senses, although he did not have the so-called spiritual consciousness of a strong person who was born with a pill, Li Muhuo found that his five senses had improved horribly. He could even feel the weak vibrations a thousand meters away, could feel the flow of the wind when it blew on his body, and could even clearly feel the weight of a grain of dust falling on his body.
In order to prove his strength, Li Muhuo picked up a piece of gravel on the ground and flicked it casually. He saw a faint white light flash away. The next moment, a huge stone not far away, which was at least several hundred kilograms, exploded with a bang.
"Hiss~"
Li Muhuo looked around quickly, then disappeared into the night as if he had slipped away.
When leaving, Li Muhuo also made some observations and found that within a thousand meters, everything withered, and even the big trees died directly. You can imagine the majestic vitality required for his breakthrough.
"It seems that next time I want to practice the body training method, I have to prepare a large amount of vitality pills."
Li Muhuo took advantage of the darkness and quietly returned to the workshop. As for the vision by the river, he had no choice but to pretend he didn't know anything.
Early next day.
Li Muhuo was as angry as ever, and Lin Yue called him to practice sword practice.
"Huh?"
When Li Muhuo opened the door, Lin Yue was obviously stunned and looked at Li Muhuo with some confusion.
Li Muhuo's heart suddenly became tense, and he muttered a little, maybe he has changed a little bit?
After he came back, he obviously checked himself again. Except that his body looked thinner than before, his muscles were tighter, and his skin was slightly smoother, there didn't seem to be any major changes.
But he heard Lin Yue say: "Have you achieved another breakthrough in your Iron Bone Kung Fu?"
Li Muhuo nodded quickly and said in surprise: "Brother, how do you know?"
When Lin Yue heard that this was indeed the case, he said: "Although the change is not big, I can still see that your overall temperament has improved."
After saying that, Lin Yue snorted again and said: "You are the only one who always says that your qualifications are not good. It is recognized that body training is more difficult than Qi training. It is not uncommon for you to be promoted to the fourth level of body tempering in just three years. At least, if you show your talent for body training when you enter, you will definitely not be assigned to the handyman disciples."
When Li Muhuo heard this, he was still slightly alert. He was still progressing too fast.
During the body training process, the transformation of the body is still too obvious. It seems that I still have to practice Qigong in the future, at least so that there will be no external changes.
After a while, the two continued to practice their swordsmanship.
After a while, the third senior brother yawned and went into the dining room to make breakfast. Qian Duoduo seemed to have eyes. Less than ten breaths after the third senior brother entered the dining room, he walked out and went straight to the dining room.
